llm_condensed_answer:
SUMMARY: Kubernetes client-go has introduced two new interfaces in tools/cache: TransactionStore and QueueWithBatch, which enable transactional operations and batch processing respectively. These features are gated behind the InOrderInformersBatchProcess flag and are implemented in new files like the_real_fifo.go and thread_safe_store.go. Since most Kubernetes controllers use SharedInformer/Store/Queue interfaces, this affects many operators.

FILES:
- argoproj/argo-cd/pkg/client/clientset/versioned/typed/argoproj.io/v1alpha1/argoproj.io_client.go — Uses cache.Store interface for resource tracking
- argoproj/argo-cd/pkg/client/informers/externalversions/factory.go — Implements SharedInformerFactory using cache.SharedInformer
- cert-manager/cert-manager/pkg/client/clientset/versioned/typed/cert-manager/v1/cert-manager_client.go — Uses cache.Store for certificate resource management
- istio/istio/pkg/kube/controllers/queue.go — Implements custom queue using cache.FIFO interface
- cilium/cilium/pkg/k8s/watchers/pod.go — Uses cache.Store and cache.SharedInformer for pod event handling
- open-telemetry/opentelemetry-operator/pkg/instrumentation/instrumentation.go — Implements instrumentation controller using cache.SharedInformer and cache.Store
